title: Checked Multiply
summary: Return a * b, or fail with an error that mentions "overflow" when the exact product doesn't fit in a signed 64-bit integer (from -2^63 to 2^63 - 1).
hints: Try 4294967296 * 4294967296 in your language first. Depending on the track it wraps to 0, panics, turns into a float, or just works.
Use what your language offers: a checked multiply, a check on the result's type, or a comparison in a wider type.
TypeScript and QML: 9223372036854775807 can't be written as a number; it becomes 2^63. Compare with >= 2 ** 63, not > 9223372036854775807.

cases.description: close to the largest safe integer
